playbook:
When I'm dealt KING and I am to act first, I bet to build the pot and apply pressure.
When I'm dealt KING and my opponent checks to me, I bet for value; if they bet into me, I call.
When I'm dealt QUEEN and I am to act first, I usually bet to protect and pressure; be willing to check in very marginal boardless spots only rarely.
When I'm dealt QUEEN and my opponent checks to me, I bet to try to take the pot.
When I'm dealt QUEEN and my opponent bets into me, I call a 1-chip bet (don't fold Q to a single bet).
When I'm dealt JACK and I am to act first, default to checking (avoid frequent bluffs as opener).
When I'm dealt JACK and my opponent checks to me, only bet as an occasional, infrequent bluff—do not bluff with J routinely.
When I'm dealt JACK and my opponent bets into me, fold to protect chips unless pot odds or reads strongly justify calling.
Always declare my actual card at showdown—be truthful on every [show:X].
